title: Docs/clarify windows config paths
body:
While looking into containers/podman#29233, I noticed that the Windows documentation could be clearer.

This PR adds clarification about how `containers.conf` works with `podman machine`, including the correct location for configuration files on Windows, how to verify they're available inside the VM, and what to do on older Podman versions.

Related to containers/podman#29233.
